description: extractOz is an R package for extracting agricultural context at Australian GPS points. The Western Australian agriculture repository README lists GRDC agroecological zones, major soil orders and weather records and describes a generic function for the user's own geospatial layer. Users supply sampling coordinates or a vector file; outputs are joined zone, soil and climate attributes for the selected sites. Geographic coverage is Australia for the included layers. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the package, while underlying government and research maps may have separate rights. A limitation is that point extraction inherits the spatial scale and date of each source raster or polygon; a field can cross multiple soil classes. extractOz can prepare crop, irrigation and agricultural supply-chain simulation inputs. The related QGIS catalogue platform is a broader GIS environment. No atlas data or package was downloaded.
